title: VisualFrameEvent v1
description: R4 visual context frame metadata + OCR text (issue #68). Raw pixels optional; never log ocrText or image bytes.

consent.description: Operator explicit consent for this capture

ocrText.description: OCR/description text after optional PII masking

ocrEngine.description: Engine id, e.g. fake, tesseract, remote-policy

masked.description: True if PII masking was applied

linkedEventId.description: Optional transcript HubEvent id near capture time

source.description: Capture source label, e.g. shell-stub, windows-dxgi

contentType.description: If image bytes were accepted, e.g. image/png

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of image bytes if stored or hashed; never the bytes themselves in logs
